decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 18 August 2005 the single storey detached building, for use as a garden shed, measuring 3.9 metres long, 3.5 metres wide and 4 	metres high to top of ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following 	reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 
Condition : 2 - Informative: 
The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 9 Bristow Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other 	business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen 	facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey garden shed to rear of garden of house
